# ABC News

> > Major American broadcast news network providing breaking news, investigative reporting, and multimedia coverage of U.S. politics, international affairs, and global events.

ABC News delivers comprehensive news coverage across multiple platforms including television, digital, and video streaming. The network covers major political developments, international conflicts, and breaking stories with a focus on the White House, Pentagon, Congress, and global hotspots including Iran, Israel, Ukraine, and other regions of geopolitical significance.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Iran Conflict
- White House Coverage
- Pentagon & Defense
- International Affairs
- U.S. Politics
- Israel & Middle East
- Ukraine Crisis
- FBI & Law Enforcement
- Live News Updates
- Polling & Public Opinion
- Survey Methodology
- World News Reporting

## Core News Sections

- [ABC News Homepage](https://abcnews.com/): Breaking news, latest headlines, and live updates on Iran, Israel, and major global events
- [Politics](https://abcnews.com/politics): Political news and analysis covering Trump, Iran conflict, Pentagon, Congress, and White House developments
- [International News](https://abcnews.com/International): World news coverage including Hungary, Ukraine, China, and international conflicts
- [Video Hub](https://abcnews.com/Video): News video clips, live streams, and multimedia coverage of breaking stories and political events

## News Standards & Methodology

- [ABC News Polling Guide](https://a.abcnews.com/sections/politics/dailynews/poll_explainer.html): Comprehensive guide to ABC News polling methodology, survey techniques, and random sampling practices

## Optional

- [50 Most Popular Women on the Web](https://abcnews.com/Technology/50-popular-women-web-google-search-results/story?id=10573331): Archive article analyzing Google search trends for most-searched women including Lady Gaga and celebrities
